understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the KA59 puzzle run by solving each level within its step budget, where a level is won only when every goal tile marked with a `+` is simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece (i.e., all goals must be covered at once to trigger WIN).
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were either directional moves (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) that attempted to move the currently selected piece by one grid cell, or CLICK [x,y] which attempted to move the selected piece to the clicked position according to the level’s movement rules. Movement only succeeded if the destination path/cell was valid; walls/obstacles blocked movement, and if another piece/solid object was in the way the move would fail unless the rules allowed pushing (in this run, attempted moves frequently resulted in no displacement due to blocking). Selection persisted between actions, and repeated clicks on blocked tiles produced no movement effect.
